

  The bill having received a constitutional majority was declared to
have passed the House and the title was agreed to.

                          Ways and Means Calendar

  Senate File 639, a bill for an act creating a specialty business court,
and including effective date provisions, was taken up for consideration.
111th Day                         SATURDAY, MAY 2, 2026                   1101



   Lawler of Johnson offered amendment H–8440 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–8440 was adopted.

   Thomson of Floyd offered amendment H–8456 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

  Roll call was requested by Thomson of Floyd and Cisneros of
Muscatine.

   On the question “Shall amendment H–8456 be adopted?” (S.F. 639)

   Rule 75 invoked.

   The ayes were, 8:

Hayes                  Larson             Thomson         Williams

   Amendment H–8456 lost.

   Lawler of Johnson offered amendment H–8447 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–8447 was adopted.

   Lawler of Johnson moved that the bill be read a last time now and
placed upon its passage which motion prevailed and the bill was read
a last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” (H.F. 639)
